issues: ISSUE-T012-1 (P2, open): p95 <= 500ms missed in BOTH full-suite parallel acceptance runs: 527.4ms (run A) and 649.2ms (run B, final). Standalone UI runs pass at 263.2ms / 282.8ms; Node in-process kernel at 109.7ms. Within each full-suite run the last ~5 timings fall back to the standalone range once the sibling worker finished, proving parallel-worker CPU contention on this 1.5-vCPU shared VM, not a product slowdown. Per IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §11 this is a P2 candidate. No table changed, no downsampling, no invented numbers; all five 30-value datasets preserved in T012-performance.json and artifacts/logs/T012-perf-browser*.json.

ISSUE-T012-2 (P2, open): the Cancel button is unobservable in the real browser: analyze() is synchronous on the main thread (async signature, no real await), so React batches ANALYZING true->false into one render. 3 in-page 1ms-poll probes on the 32x12 table all observed clicked=false. The jobId guard is proven instead by the race test (two back-to-back analyses, newest result wins). Re-test after Worker wiring (T013).

ISSUE-T012-3 (closed in this card): Vitest's default include (**/*.{test,spec}.*) executed the new Playwright *.spec.ts files and failed them at import time, making npm run test exit 1 once (719 unit tests themselves all passed). Fixed by renaming E2E files to *.e2e.ts + testMatch in playwright.config.ts; npm run test is back to 719/719 exit 0. vite.config.ts untouched.

ISSUE-T012-4 (recorded, environment): vite preview binds [::1]:4173 by default on this VM, so the 127.0.0.1 readiness check failed and the first webServer start timed out after 60s. Fixed with --host 127.0.0.1 in playwright.config.ts; not a product defect.
notes: 21 E2E tests (20 functional in tests/e2e/tablefork.e2e.ts + 1 perf in tests/e2e/performance.e2e.ts), all run in real Chromium 159.0.8154.6 against the production build (vite preview, webServer rebuilds first). 20/21 pass in both full-suite runs; the only failure is the p95 assertion (ISSUE-T012-1).
